title: 第三十章 全部觉醒成功！
content_zh:
第三十章 全部觉醒成功！-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

在爻雪不知道的地方，苏辰已经将接下来一个月的事情给计划好了，首先就是帮助爻雪完成任务，只有这样才能将一个月之后要发生的事情传递到其他地方，让更多的人知道。

然后就是提升实力，收集物资，建造幸存者基地。

虽然有些商店能够升级，但苏辰很清楚，并不是所有人都有勇气去杀怪物的，不能杀怪物就无法获得晶核，没有晶核就住不起游戏商店，所以幸存者基地还是需要建造的。

然后就是帮助爻雪升级游戏商店。

这件事他准备等任务完成之后再去问问店长，游戏商店升级到底需要什么条件。

就在苏辰计划这些的时候，另一边，苏辰的队员在游戏商店的天台处找到了正在给异能觉醒药剂分装的爻雪。

看到有人来，爻雪也没有废话，直接开门见山地说道：“你们队长应该已经将事情跟你们说了吧。”

闻言，众人点了点头，“店长，我们已经知道了，你放心，我们一定会帮你完成任务的，一个月之后我们也不会让你失望的。”

爻雪看向说话的那个人，好像是叫小六，这应该是外号吧。

她打断小六的话，说道：“别跟我说这些虚的，如果你们想要帮忙，那就向你们的队长学习，一次就将异能觉醒出来，我先跟你们透个底，我制作异能觉醒药剂需要大量的晶核，面前的这三十多瓶已经是全部了。

而且，这些异能觉醒药剂也不是免费给你们的，晶核我还是要收的，但不是现在，你们可以等觉醒之后慢慢还。”

爻雪虽然也想大手一挥将异能药剂送给这些人，但没办法，身为NPC，她也是需要遵守一些规则的，另外，如果真的白送的话，其他人说不定会借机闹事。

听到爻雪这样说，几人并没有表现出任何的反感，反而是一脸的紧张。

尤其是在听到说面前的异能觉醒药剂已经是全部的时候，他们能够少用一瓶，就能多出一瓶来分给其他人使用。

一百个异能觉醒者看似数量不多，尤其是相较于整个蓝星上的幸存者而言，或许连九牛一毛都算不上，但要知道，他们可不仅仅只需要觉醒异能就行，他们还需要为一个月之后的事情做准备。

Chapter 30 All awakened successfully!- "Apocalyptic Invasion: I am an NPC in the dungeon"

Unbeknownst to Yao Xue, Su Chen had already planned what would happen in the next month. The first thing was to help Yao Xue complete the task. Only in this way could what would happen in a month be conveyed to other places and let more people know.

Then there is the matter of improving strength, collecting materials, and building a survivor base.

Although some stores can be upgraded, Su Chen knows very well that not everyone has the courage to kill monsters. If you can't kill monsters, you can't get crystal cores. Without crystal cores, you can't afford to live in the game store, so a survivor base still needs to be built.

Then it is to help Yaoxue upgrade the game store.

He planned to ask the store manager what conditions were needed to upgrade the game store after the task was completed.

Just as Su Chen was planning this, on the other side, Su Chen's team members found Yao Xue on the rooftop of the game store who was packaging the power awakening potion.

Seeing someone coming, Yaoxue didn't waste any time and said straight to the point: "Your captain should have already told you about the matter."

Hearing this, everyone nodded, "Store manager, we already know. Don't worry, we will definitely help you complete the task. We will not let you down in a month."

Yaoxue looked at the person who spoke. It seemed that his name was Xiaoliu. This should be a nickname.

She interrupted Xiao Liu and said: "Don't tell me these nonsense. If you want to help, then learn from your captain and awaken the superpower in one go. Let me explain to you first. I need a lot of crystal cores to make the superpower awakening potion. These more than thirty bottles in front of me are all.

Moreover, these power awakening potions are not given to you for free. I still have to collect the crystal cores, but not now. You can pay them back slowly after you awaken."

Although Yaoxue also wanted to give the supernatural potion to these people with a wave of her hand, she had no choice. As an NPC, she also needed to abide by some rules. In addition, if it was really given away for free, others might take the opportunity to cause trouble.

Hearing Yaoxue say this, the few people did not show any disgust, but looked nervous.

Especially when they heard that they had all the power awakening potion in front of them, if they could use one less bottle, they would have an extra bottle for others to use.

A hundred people with awakened powers may seem like a small number, especially compared to the survivors on the entire Blue Star. They may not even be counted as a drop in the bucket, but you must know that they not only need to awaken their powers, they also need to prepare for what will happen in a month.
